exposure: California Maternal Quality Care Collaborative (CMQCC) risk assessment tool
American College of Obstetrics and Gynecology Safe Motherhood Initiative (ACOG SMI) risk assessment tool
Association of Women's Health, Obstetric and Neonatal Nurses (AWHONN) risk assessment tool
cohort: The cohort consisted of 11,679 people who delivered liveborn infants at the study center from January 2018 to June 2021.
finding: All three antepartum risk assessment tools (CMQCC, ACOG SMI, AWHONN) were found to be poor predictors of significant postpartum hemorrhage upon admission to labor and delivery, showing low sensitivity and moderately poor area under the receiver operating characteristics curves.
